scope: Optional mass/volume concentration on homogeneous solution initialization and ordinary volume transfers
invariants: Concentration belongs to a load, never shared content identity
Solute mass equals declared concentration times solution volume
Solute mass cannot contribute additional solution volume
Each solute retains identity and conserves quantity through ordinary transfer
Unknown/undeclared same-solute quantity bases are rejected, not treated as zero
Current concentrations derive from current mass and volume; zero volume yields no value
Unsupported solid, bare-mass, unknown and associated mixtures roll back the rejected material step
Explicit zero and positive trace solutes survive ordinary volume transfer
